measurement: Same 80 frames at fixed viewport. Frame includes two simulation ticks, snapshot, renderer submission and gl.finish; excludes capture, PNG encoding and rAF. Software SwiftShader, not hardware GPU FPS.
method: 21 catalog creatures, real attack commands against paired soldiers, 160 simulation ticks. Attack/idle/walk modes are observed, not forced. Cast coverage is reviewed separately in painter sheets.
